scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features canister-api && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:v1: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features canister-api-v1-schema && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs_v1.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:failpoints: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features canister-api-test-failpoints && mkdir -p target/pocketic && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/ic_sqlite_vfs.wasm target/pocketic/ic_sqlite_vfs_failpoints.wasm
scripts.test:pocketic: npm run build:wasm:v1 && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:failpoints && node --test tests/pocketic/*.test.mjs
